method: Read each of the100 saved gold contexts and substitute the specified negative at the specified position; assess only the grammar violation, not historical factual accuracy. Author review, not an independent human annotation. No model outputs or held-out evaluation prompts used.
limitations: The sample is stratified by rule rather than random by frequency; zero observed errors does not prove all127625 labels correct.
Context windows omit punctuation display, although label selection checked original punctuation boundaries.
English dialects and unusual quoted/metalinguistic uses can remain ambiguous; rules intentionally skip several known cases.
